scope: Read-only offline gripper consistency audit, same70 held-out windows/7 episodes; no retraining or robot commands

encoding_decoding.units: metres; sensor widths and accepted command widths directly traced

findings: Raw target index7 maps to canonical index28; absolute gripper target in metres, no state subtraction
Recomputed training-only normalization matches saved statistics exactly; raw labels trace to accepted SDK command widths
FP32/BF16 inversion errors, KV-cache/full-forward differences, clipping, and inactive-coordinate projection do not explain the large regression
5012-step model has improved teacher-interpolation denoising MSE but much stronger initial-noise sensitivity in free sampling
Original single-seed best-checkpoint conclusion applies to that seed only; some other seeds improve, but worst-case robustness deteriorates
Source sample_beta is a power-uniform ratio, not standard Beta; fixed t=.5 loss misses high-noise weaknesses; causal effect of changing time distribution not yet tested

recommendation.loss: Track gripper separately; prioritize first1/10 actions rather than only mean over50x8; test stronger gripper supervision or bounded deterministic gripper head
recommendation.evaluation: Fixed seeds predeclared with positive/negative noise; report mean/worst-case MAE and false-open rate on closed commands; t=.1/.5/.9 flow losses
recommendation.time_distribution: Treat proper Beta or stratified/end-point-rich time sampling as a controlled ablation, not a proven repair
recommendation.do_not: Do not select a favorable seed as a fix; do not replace closed command targets with measured contact widths
